messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up: Marigold wants a week-long POC to validate 'marigold-13b-lite' + a q4_0 quant variant for edge orchestration. They need latency for streaming, model fidelity notes, a security Q form filled, and a short POC price. Can we triage?

nina_se: I can do the fidelity/eval diff. Ask: mainly short agent commands or long context blobs?

sam_sales: Mostly short commands (~20 tokens) but occasionally attach a 900-token user history. Traffic is bursty from mobile agents.

jorge_infra: Important: marigold-13b-lite has two KV layouts in catalog: compact-kv and row-kv. compact gives better average tps, row-kv reduces tail on mixed spikes. We'll bench both.

anya_sec: From security: they check BYOK/KMS, data residency (EU), and whether we run artifact scans. Hosted POC preferred; Dedicated if HSM mandatory.

rachel_prod: For hosted we support customer-supplied KMS keys (passthrough). I'll draft a suggested paragraph for the questionnaire and a POC template.

ci-bot: Spawning ephemeral cluster for marigold tests. Job 33122 started.

jorge_infra: Bench command (internal):

```bash
redwood-bench --model marigold-13b-lite --variant q4_0,float16 --kv-layout compact-kv,row-kv --seq-dist marigold-dist.json --concurrency 10 --streaming true --measure p95,p99,tokens_per_sec
```

jorge_infra: Running quick sweep now. I'll post numbers.

nina_se: Please ask Marigold for 30 representative prompts so I can run deterministic diffs between float16 and q4_0.

sam_sales: CSM said they'll upload prompts by EOD. Goal: have bench + sec answers + pricing by Wed EOD, demo Thurs.

ci-bot: Job 33122 deployed marigold-13b-lite v1.0 on dev-pool.

jorge_infra: Quick results: compact-kv p95 short-only float16 ~100ms, q4_0 ~125ms. Mixed with 900-token spikes p95 float16 ~480ms, q4_0 ~710ms. Switching to row-kv drops p99 by ~18% on mixed workload but reduces tokens/sec ~10%.

rachel_prod: I'll include trade-offs in the POC note: recommend prefix-KV caching and routing long contexts to float16. Also propose a canary policy: use q4_0 for non-critical short commands after quality verification.

anya_sec: Draft sec language: "Hosted POC: customer-managed keys via KMS passthrough; encrypted at rest and in transit; binary checksums and internal artifact scans performed. HSM-backed keys available on Dedicated/Private deployments." I'll attach onboarding summary.

nina_se: Uploaded preliminary diff on 30 prompts: ~3.5% divergence, mostly numeric formatting and a couple stop-token differences. Will run a targeted pass to produce a delta table.

sam_sales: Good. Action recap: @nina_se run detailed diffs once prompts complete; @jorge_infra attach full bench logs and mitigation checklist; @anya_sec finalize questionnaire answers and attach audit summary; @rachel_prod prepare 1-page POC price card. Deliver by Wed EOD.

ci-bot: Job 33122 artifacts archived.

jorge_infra: Logs posted. Noted: if Marigold wants stricter tail latency we should propose Dedicated dev pool for the demo (fewer noisy neighbors) or enable caching.

sam_sales: I'll update Marigold: demo tentative pending quality check and we'll request prompts now. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
